description: Code fill-in-the-middle (Mistral FIM-compatible) — Drop-in for Mistral's Codestral FIM endpoint (POST /v1/fim/completions): send {model, prompt, suffix?, max_tokens?, temperature?, stop?} where prompt is the code before the cursor and suffix the code after; returns the missing middle as choices[0].message.content in the chat.completion shape with usage. Fences and repeated prefix/suffix are stripped. Served by Llama 3.3 70B, non-streaming; pay per call with x402, no API key. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: fim_completions
